sections.heading: A Doctor Who Believes in Treating the Root Cause
sections.markdown:
![Dr. Raghavendra Kulkarni](assets/img/profile-photo.jpg)

At the Asian Institute of Nephrology and Urology, Secunderabad, Dr. Raghavendra Kulkarni is known not only for his clinical excellence, but also for the warmth, trust, and reassurance he brings to every patient interaction. With over 28 years of experience in medicine and 14 years dedicated exclusively to Urology, he has become a trusted name for patients seeking ethical, advanced, and patient-focused urological care.

Dr. Kulkarni believes that successful treatment begins with understanding the patient completely — their symptoms, concerns, lifestyle, and expectations. His calm and approachable nature helps patients feel comfortable discussing even the most sensitive urological problems with confidence.

## A Doctor Who Believes in Treating the Root Cause

.Rather than simply managing symptoms, Dr. Kulkarni focuses on identifying the root cause of the condition and offering precise, evidence-based treatment plans. His approach is practical, transparent, and tailored to every individual patient.

Patients value him for:

-   Honest and ethical medical advice
-   Clear explanation of treatment options
-   Minimal and necessary investigations only
-   Availability and supportive patient care
-   Focus on long-term recovery and quality of life

## International Training. Advanced Expertise.

After completing his MBBS, MS, and MCh in Urology, Dr. Kulkarni pursued advanced fellowship training in the United Kingdom. He was awarded the prestigious Fellowship of the International Surgical Training Programme in Urology by The Royal College of Surgeons, England.

During his time in the UK, he received extensive training in:

-   Laser Urology
-   Laparoscopic Urology
-   Endoscopic Stone Surgery
-   Minimally Invasive Prostate Procedures

His international exposure allows him to bring globally accepted techniques and modern surgical advancements to patients in Hyderabad.

## Professional Memberships

-   Urological Society of India
-   South Zone Urological Society of India
-   Society of Genito-Urinary Surgeons, Telangana
-   Former Member – European Association of Urology
-   Former Member – American Urology Association

sections.heading: Advanced Prostate Care
sections.markdown: # Advanced Prostate Care

![Advanced Prostate Care](assets/img/prostate-ribbon.jpg)

Dr. Raghavendra Kulkarni offers comprehensive and advanced treatment solutions for enlarged prostate (BPH) and associated urinary symptoms. With expertise in modern minimally invasive and laser-based procedures, he focuses on providing effective relief, improved urinary function, reduced discomfort, and faster recovery for patients.

Using advanced technology and personalized treatment planning, Dr. Kulkarni carefully evaluates each patient’s condition and recommends the most suitable treatment approach based on age, symptoms, prostate size, and overall health.

### Treatments Offered

#### ThuFLEP Laser Therapy

A highly advanced laser procedure used to remove enlarged prostate tissue with precision. ThuFLEP helps improve urinary flow, minimizes bleeding, and offers quicker recovery with shorter hospital stay.

#### Bipolar TURP

A modern endoscopic procedure for treating prostate enlargement using bipolar energy technology. This technique effectively relieves urinary obstruction with improved safety and faster healing.

#### REZUM Water Vapour Therapy

A minimally invasive treatment that uses controlled water vapour therapy to reduce enlarged prostate tissue. REZUM is designed to improve urinary symptoms while preserving quality of life and reducing recovery time.

#### Minimally Invasive Surgical Therapy (MIST)

Advanced minimally invasive procedures performed to treat prostate enlargement with less pain, minimal bleeding, shorter hospitalization, and quicker return to daily activities.

Dr. Kulkarni’s goal is to help patients regain comfort, confidence, and better urinary health through safe, effective, and evidence-based prostate care.

With years of specialized experience in modern urology, he focuses on delivering personalized, evidence-based care using advanced technology and minimally invasive techniques whenever possible.

His patient-centered approach ensures that every individual receives detailed evaluation, accurate diagnosis, and treatment tailored to their specific condition, symptoms, and lifestyle needs.

Advanced minimally invasive laparoscopic procedures performed for various urological conditions, offering smaller incisions, reduced pain, quicker recovery, and shorter hospital stay.

Specialized surgical treatments aimed at restoring normal urinary tract function and improving quality of life in patients with structural or functional urological problems.

Detailed assessment and treatment for blood in urine, including identification of underlying causes through advanced diagnostic evaluation and appropriate management.

Expert care for urinary difficulties such as weak urine flow, incomplete bladder emptying, urinary frequency, and nighttime urination.

Comprehensive diagnosis and treatment for testicular pain, swelling, infections, torsion, and related conditions with timely medical and surgical management when required.

### Penile Prosthesis

Advanced surgical solutions for erectile dysfunction through penile prosthesis procedures aimed at restoring confidence, function, and quality of life.

Dr. Kulkarni is committed to providing ethical, compassionate, and advanced urology care with a strong emphasis on patient comfort, safety, and long-term well-being.

sections.heading: Kidney Stone Treatment
sections.markdown: # Kidney Stone Treatment

![Kidney Stone Treatment](assets/img/kidney-model-pills.jpg)

Dr. Raghavendra Kulkarni offers advanced and minimally invasive treatment solutions for kidney stones and urinary tract stones. With extensive expertise in Laser and Endoscopic Stone Surgery, he provides effective stone management focused on accurate diagnosis, complete stone clearance, reduced discomfort, and faster recovery.

Using modern technology and personalized treatment planning, Dr. Kulkarni carefully evaluates the size, location, and complexity of the stones to recommend the most suitable treatment option for each patient. His approach emphasizes minimally invasive techniques that help patients return to normal activities quickly with minimal pain and shorter hospital stays.

### Treatments Offered

#### RIRS (Retrograde Intrarenal Surgery)

A highly advanced minimally invasive procedure performed using a flexible endoscope and laser technology to remove kidney stones without any external cuts or incisions. RIRS is especially effective for stones located inside the kidney and offers faster recovery with minimal discomfort.

#### PCNL (Percutaneous Nephrolithotomy)

An advanced procedure used for treating large or complex kidney stones through a small incision in the back. PCNL allows efficient removal of larger stones with excellent outcomes and reduced recovery time.

#### MiniPerc & UltraMiniPerc

Modern minimally invasive variations of PCNL performed using smaller instruments for reduced pain, less bleeding, and quicker healing while effectively treating kidney stones.

#### Laser Stone Surgery

Advanced laser technology used to precisely break kidney and urinary tract stones into smaller fragments for safe and effective removal. Laser stone treatment offers high precision with minimal damage to surrounding tissues.

#### Endoscopic Stone Removal

Minimally invasive endoscopic procedures used to diagnose and remove stones from the urinary tract without large incisions, ensuring improved patient comfort and faster recovery.

Dr. Kulkarni is committed to providing safe, advanced, and patient-focused kidney stone treatment with the goal of preventing recurrence, preserving kidney health, and improving overall quality of life.
